subject: english
stem: Wetlands slow moving water, trap some dirt, and give many young fish shelter. What does the text explain?
options: Wetlands remove every kind of pollution.
Young fish make all water move faster.
Shelters are built only for people.
Wetlands support cleaner water and wildlife.

optionRationales.reason: Wetlands remove every kind of pollution.：some dirt 不等於 every。
Young fish make all water move faster.：因果相反。
Shelters are built only for people.：文本指 fish。
Wetlands support cleaner water and wildlife.：減速沉積與魚類庇護共同支持。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「標題、重複概念與各句共同說明的對象指向文章核心」可推出 Wetlands support cleaner water and wildlife.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Wetlands support cleaner water and wildlife. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
